newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Gas says gas rate cut unlikely.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Gas says gas rate cut unlikely.

text.p: Tokyo Gas Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would be difficult for gas companies to lower rates at this point.

A Tokyo Gas spokesman quoted chairman Hiroshi Watanabe as telling a news conference that although some electric power utilities have made clear their intention to try to trim rates, city gas companies were unlikely to follow suit with similar steps.

Faced with mounting pressure to slash rates paid by consumers, Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) and a handful of other electric power firms recently announced plans to cut rates. None of the firms have said by how much the rates would be cut.
Tokyo Gas is Japan's largest city gas company.
